name: Ethan A. Hougah

biography.text: Hougah earned a B.A. from Rutgers University–Camden (2005) and a J.D. from Boston College Law School (2010). He clerked for New Jersey Superior Court Judge David W. Morgan, then-Magistrate Judge Karen M. Williams, and Magistrate Judge Steven C. Mannion. He practiced at Bressler Amery & Ross and Montgomery McCracken, becoming a partner at the latter before his appointment.
